## `check` against both references: `e2e-ref` (the twin, compiled by Lean) and `con-ron` (the Rust binary)

`con-ron --jobs=1 --pins P FILE` at the vendored revision (exit codes: 0 accept, 1 reject, 2 decline, 3 error; `P`: the same pin list as the others, `natOpPinSets.take 1` in its `con-ron-pins/1` format), `e2e-ref FILE --pins=1`, and the compiled `check`. Accept is the verdict compared.

| con-ron | e2e-ref | L `check` | fixtures |
|---|---|---|---:|
| accept | accept | – | 404 |
| reject | reject | – | 170 |
| decline | decline | – | 52 |
| reject | reject | no | 36 |
| error | error | no | 4 |
| decline | decline | no | 3 |
| accept | accept | no | 3 |
| timeout | timeout | – | 2 |
| exit -6 | memout | – | 1 |

* All three agree on accept/not on **43** of 675 fixtures; con-ron and `e2e-ref` disagree on **0**.

## Per-function differential tests (`e2e-diff`)

From each fixture, the twin's state and L's memory after the stages before the fold (`internReservedPins`, `parseBytes`, `internAllPins`; L: `e2e_front()`); the stores' node counts compared; then up to 200 persistent expression handles per fixture through `whnf`, `whnf_core`, `infer` on both sides (verified mode, the empty environment). `both err`: the twin throws and L aborts.

* Front: 22 fixtures where both succeed; stores agree on 22, **differ on 0**.

| function | handles | agree | disagree | L error, twin ok | L ok, twin error | both err | missing |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `infer` | 4408 | 30 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 4378 |  |
| `whnf` | 4408 | 4318 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 88 | `find_proj` 2 |
| `whnf_core` | 4408 | 4318 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 88 | `find_proj` 2 |
